title: Hygiene appointment booking
transcript:
Rep: Hi, thanks for calling Northstar. How can I help today?
Caller: I'd like to book a cleaning next Tuesday morning.
Rep: Sure — I have Tuesday at 10:00 AM available. Does that work?
Caller: Yes, perfect.
Rep: Great, you're booked for Tuesday at 10. I'll send a confirmation and reminder.
Caller: Thank you!
